text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. My body feels a little flushed, but... it won't be a problem.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: During summer training camp, Red Desire kept her training within reasonable limits while focusing thoroughly on her "recuperation."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... during training, she seemed to tire
far more easily than before, leaving me deeply
concerned about her condition.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
......
There is no need to worry; everything is proceeding smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Because you support me,
the saint's power remains untainted.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Even in the Sapporo Kinen,
I shall without fail seize the radiance of victory."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "With the Sapporo Kinen drawing closer by the moment, Red Desire must be feeling anxious too."
choice_data_list: (Still... she doesn't show any sign of that at all.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was frustrating to realize that I had neither a way
to wipe away her anxiety nor a single witty word of comfort to offer.
......I can't let things go on like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It was a very quiet night.
Yet, feeling somewhat restless... I stepped outside—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
You were called here as well, weren't you?
choice_data_list: Huh? What do you mean by that...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Cafe-san... is that you?
You are the one who called us, correct...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Cafe-san...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Grant me guidance——...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Cafe-san... is that you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe seemed cloaked in a denser aura of illusions and the abyss than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...May guidance find you...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...There is no need to worry.
Let us be on our way...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My memory of what happened after that is hazy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Guided by a mysterious presence
taking the form of Manhattan Cafe――...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading deep into the secluded forest,
what she arrived at was—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: My goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a beautiful flower field,
where colorful petals swayed in the gentle breeze.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: It's wonderful... —Wait, where... on earth am I...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This place is... a "place of rest."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Cafeee!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A group of Umamusume comes running over.
They look to be about the same age as Red Desire.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Somehow, all of them seemed
to resemble Red Desire."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Is that child a newcomer?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...That is correct. Her name is Desire-san.
Please be good friends with her, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Welcome, Desire-san!"
"If there's anything you don't understand,
just ask!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes... The pleasure is mine.
I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving behind a cheerful greeting, the running Umamusume
were watched over by Red Desire for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I wonder why...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...The aura they emanate...
I can hardly believe they're strangers to me..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Cafe-san, please enlighten me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "This place is... Just what kind of place is this 'Haven of Rest'...?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Besides, those people are...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...You feel it too, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "The air in this place... is exceptionally clear..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It's so much easier to breathe...
It feels as though the ache throughout my body is fading away...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"In this flower field...
the unbroken chain of prayers engraved in our souls—
overflows as a healing power."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The power to save you from the "Crimson Wedge"...
and push you forward toward the future "they" wished for.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
All the girls who spend their time here...
just like you, reached out for
the brilliance of the Tiara...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Gathered under a grand destinyâ
this is a place where everyone huddles close
to live and fight their own individual trials.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I... we are...—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Is everyone connected... somewhere far away?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Everyone is connected to me... and to my "friend."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
What connects us is,
you could say... 'fate'.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A connection...
Between me and Cafe-san...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: With Cafe-san's "friend"...――

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The "Resting Place" is also...
a special sanctuary protected by
our "Friends."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And now...
the power of this place is growing stronger.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
To those of you defying fate...
my "friend" wishes to lend you their strength—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I feel the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You are not alone.
You are part of an unbroken chain of destiny...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It is our hope.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't able to completely comprehend
everything Manhattan Cafe told me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the clear air of this place
is certainly having some sort
of positive effect."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe and her "friend"
are trying to save Red Desire
from the "Crimson Wedge."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As someone with a very deep connection.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I just wanted
to be purely grateful for that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so... Manhattan Cafe told Red Desire to rest here for a while, before quietly slipping away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Red Desire deepened her bonds with the Umamusume here through their time together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
peaceful days passed—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...How curious, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was guided here...
my heart has been so very calm.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It truly feels like my soul is being cleansed...
With this, even the "Crimson Wedge" might...—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Fufu, we shouldn't rush it, should we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—I returned to the training camp facility to make adjustments ahead of the Sapporo Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The Sapporo Kinen...
will mark our fresh start."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Let us brace ourselves and proceed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Red Desire smiling nobly,
I sensed signs of recovery... and an aura
of pure, lucid spirituality.
